# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

The best pick depends on your phone and your vents. Here are the top options from the sources, with where to look at each.

**Best for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount, $47.99**
- It includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so you don't need to buy a power source.
- It rotates between portrait and landscape and takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Check your vents first. Belkin says slats should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones may droop.
- Three of the guides pick it as best overall: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/) and [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/). They link to Amazon, but the results gave me no direct product URL.

**Fastest charging: Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933), $89.99**
- It has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, which helps when navigation and sun are heating your phone.
- Anker lists the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus at up to 25W, the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro at up to 22W, and the iPhone Air at up to 20W. iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W.
- It doesn't work with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles, or with cars that lack standard vent blades. The iPhone 16e isn't compatible.
- The sources disagree on the adapter. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) and [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) say a 60W adapter is in the box. The RottenWiFi review says you need a 45W+ adapter. Confirm what's included before you buy.
- The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale.

**Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost, $39.99**
- It has Qi2 certification (Qi-ID 21376), a fan, and mounts on a vent or dashboard.
- Code PARTNER18 brings it to $32.80. It expires 2026-12-31.
- The product page doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, and The Gadgeteer says it isn't, so budget about $10–15 for one.
- [Buy it at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy, at no cost to you. Details are in [their writeup](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-magsafe-car-mount-2026-reviews-qi2).
- The Gadgeteer lists different prices for this mount ($35.99 and $18.99). I'd trust the ESR store price.

**Budget 25W with an adapter included: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, $39.95**
- It ships with a 95W adapter, but I found no independent testing of it. See [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).
- It only reaches 25W with the fan on. With the fan off it's capped at 15W.

## Quick picks
- **Simple and complete in the box:** Belkin.
- **Newest iPhone and fastest charging:** Anker Prime, if your car isn't a Tesla or Mercedes.
- **Cheapest decent fan-cooled option:** ESR CryoBoost with the code, plus a car charger.

Which iPhone do you have, and are your vents horizontal or vertical? That would help me narrow it to one.
